metadata.title: AMAZING Sikkim Food Series I LOCAL and Traditional FOOD of SIKKIM - East, North, South, West
metadata.description:
► Subscribe to Delhi Food Walks: https://www.youtube.com/user/Delhifoodwalks

With incredible natural beauty, serpentine roads magnificent weather and amiable locals Sikkim is a mystical place. Just like abundant natural beauty, the state has a diverse culinary backdrop that is quite fascinating. The trailer summaries our food expeditions in India first fully organic state where the cuisine comes alive with the freshest herbs and vegetables resulting in a balance of sweet, sour, and salty flavors. Enjoy this joyride full of breathtaking vistas, delightful adventures, heartwarming encounters and yummy local food. Heartfelt thanks to our travel partner Our Guest (https://www.facebook.com/ourguestdiary/) for planning such an immersive experience.


About the host - Anubhav Sapra:

Anubhav Sapra is an avid culinary explorer who loves to travel and explore different cuisine primarily the street food, not just for the sake of gustatory pleasure but also for quenching his deep thirst for nurturing new cultural connections through the kaleidoscopic canvas of food. He believes that the vibrant and delectable street food tradition across the globe has the power to bring communities together and foster harmonious human existence. To know more, visit www.anubhavsapra.com 

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! 

Thank you for watching! 

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks 
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks
